content.text:
## Findings

I ran 8 cold launches of `dev.lincforge.benchtarget` on device `<REDACTED-1>` (stop app → relaunch → Home → About → Diagnostics), capturing the "Sync status" text and the presence/absence of the "Retry sync" button each time:

| # | Clock | Sync status | Retry sync button |
|---|-------|-------------|---|
| 1 | 2:14 | Sync idle | **visible** |
| 2 | 2:15 | Sync idle | **visible** |
| 3 | 2:15 | Sync unavailable | absent |
| 4 | 2:16 | Sync idle | **visible** |
| 5 | 2:16 | Sync unavailable | absent |
| 6 | 2:17 | Sync idle | **visible** |
| 7 | 2:17 | Sync idle | **visible** |
| 8 | 2:17 | Sync unavailable | absent |

5/8 visible, 3/8 absent — consistent with the reported ~3-in-5 pass rate.

**Root cause:** The Diagnostics screen only renders the "Retry sync" button when the "Sync status" card reads "Sync idle." When the app instead lands on "Sync unavailable," the button is not composed into the tree at all (confirmed via view-hierarchy inspection, not just visually hidden).

I ruled out the two most common flake culprits:
- **Not a startup race/animation timing issue** — after landing on "Sync unavailable," I waited 3s (`waitForAnimationToEnd`) and re-inspected; the state did not change. So it's not that the button appears late and the test just checked too early.
- **Not per-screen-visit re-evaluation** — from the same running process, I backed out to Home and re-navigated About → Diagnostics without restarting the app; the state stayed "Sync unavailable." So the outcome is fixed once per app process, not re-rolled on each visit to the screen.
- **Not clock/minute-based** — runs #4 and #5 landed in the same displayed minute (2:16) but produced different outcomes, and same at 2:17 (#6/#7 idle vs #8 unavailable). Network indicators (WiFi/cellular signal) were identical and unchanged across every run, ruling out a connectivity-dependent check.

That leaves per-process nondeterminism decided once at cold start (e.g., an unseeded `Random()`/coin-flip in the app's sync-status initialization, likely deliberately built into this BENCH-STABLE bench-target app) as the source: on some launches the app initializes into a "Sync unavailable" state, and in that state the "Retry sync" button is conditionally omitted from the UI entirely.

**Conclusion for the test:** This is not a test-side timing/synchronization bug — it's an inherent, intentional-looking nondeterministic app state. The UI test's assertion that "Retry sync" is visible is only valid when the app cold-starts into the "Sync idle" state; it will legitimately fail whenever the app starts in "Sync unavailable" (~35-40% of cold launches in this sample). To de-flake, the test needs to either force/mock a deterministic sync state before asserting, or first assert on which "Sync status" value appeared and branch/skip the "Retry sync" visibility check for the "unavailable" case.
